edits.before: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Mandate or Liandry's-lite lines, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Hostile Takeover’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Hostile Takeover’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Bank Dark Binding visibly against her — she's immobile with no dash, so a landed root ahead of her carry's damage window is close to a guaranteed trade.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Black Shield only stops magical CC — save it for her Handshake root/pull, not for chip poke that Loyalty Program's shield already eats.

edits.before: - Renata Glasc Hostile Takeover: matchup-defining — The berserk wave turns your team on itself — never group in a line against it. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Black Shield banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Hostile Takeover (R, 150/130/110s) berserks your team if you group in a line against it — never stack for it. - Bank Black Shield for Handshake (Q, 16s CD) rather than chip poke. - Loyalty Program (E) shields on a 14/13/12/11/10s cycle.

edits.before: Renata's threat is Handshake (E) — a long-range grab that flings you toward her ADC. Hold Black Shield for that E, because blocking the root/pull denies her entire setup; then W-punish her while she's on cooldown.
edits.after: Renata's threat is Handshake (Q) — a long-range grab that flings you toward her ADC. Hold Black Shield for that Q, because blocking the root/pull denies her entire setup; then W-punish her while she's on cooldown.

edits.before: Level 2 is a skill check between your shield timing and her E grab.
edits.after: Level 2 is a skill check between your shield timing and her Q grab.

edits.before: From 4-6 your reactive Black Shield outclasses her single grab — a blocked E or a return root leaves her helpless in your W zone with no dash. Ward wide because Renata sets up picks with her jungler using that long E range.
edits.after: From 4-6 your reactive Black Shield outclasses her single grab — a blocked Q or a return root leaves her helpless in your W zone with no dash. Ward wide because Renata sets up picks with her jungler using that long Q range.

edits.before: Save Black Shield for Handshake (E), not for poke
edits.after: Save Black Shield for Handshake (Q), not for poke

edits.before: Late Morgana erases playbooks: black-shield the engage's target and root the diver who insisted.
edits.after: Two items in, Hostile Takeover and Bailout's revive scaling tip the fight her way — her teamfight utility eventually out-values your single shield.
